description:
`artifacts/version/v1` at `/artifacts/<id>/versions/<key>`: one version,
written once.

The page is beside it as `<key>.html` or `<key>.md`. `<key>` is
`version`, the version id the Artifact tool returned, or, when it
returned none, the first 16 hex digits of `sha256`, and the record leaves
`version` out. `title` and `description` are the artifact's at this
version. A version with no local page, such as one an Artifact type
wrote, has no copy and says `copy: "none"`, and then has no `sha256`.

at.description: When the session published or read this version, with a time zone.

copy.description: none when the version has no local page, so nothing was copied.

description.description: The description the publish passed, when it passed one.

session.description: The Claude Code session that published or read this version.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the page copied beside this record, in hex.

source.description: The local file the publish sent, when a publish wrote this version.

title.description: The artifact's title at this version.

version.description: The version id the Artifact tool returned, such as 1793473476-1c42.

title: VersionRecord
